standard_prerequisites.name: A quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme admits a perfect K-injective complex that generates the derived category of quasi-coherent modules, by the Bondal-van den Bergh theorem and the existence of K-injective resolutions
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the generator K^bullet out of which the dg algebra is built.

standard_prerequisites.name: For a K-injective complex the cohomology of the dg endomorphism algebra computes the Ext groups of the corresponding object
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies H^n(E) with Ext^n(K^bullet, K^bullet), whose finiteness follows from the vanishing lemma for Ext out of perfect objects into bounded quasi-coherent complexes.

standard_prerequisites.name: The dg tensor functor - tensor^L_E K^bullet and its right adjoint R Hom(K^bullet, -), with the fully faithfulness criterion in the compact case and the equivalence criterion for a fully faithful functor whose adjoint has vanishing kernel
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: invoked at proof lines 4715-4727 and proof lines 4737-4739
standard_prerequisites.use: Assembles the equivalence from the adjunction.

core_obligations: Take the perfect K-injective generator K^bullet from the Bondal-van den Bergh theorem and define (E, d) as its dg endomorphism algebra in the dg category of complexes of O-modules; by K-injectivity H^n(E) = Ext^n(K^bullet, K^bullet), and only finitely many of these are nonzero by the Ext vanishing lemma (proof lines 4690-4708).

Consider the dg tensor functor - tensor^L_E K^bullet to D(O_X); since K^bullet is perfect hence compact, combined with the Ext identification this functor is fully faithful by the dga compact-case lemma (proof lines 4709-4722).

The functor has the right adjoint R Hom(K^bullet, -) which is a left quasi-inverse; by the tensor-with-quasi-coherent-complex lemma it lands in D_QCoh, and since K^bullet generates D_QCoh the kernel of the adjoint restricted to D_QCoh is zero; the formal adjoint-kernel lemma then upgrades this to the desired equivalence D_QCoh(O_X) equivalent to D(E, d) (proof lines 4723-4740).
proof_roadmap: Build the dg algebra from a perfect K-injective generator and check its cohomology is finite (proof lines 4690-4708).
Prove the tensor functor is fully faithful via compactness (proof lines 4709-4722).
Conclude the equivalence from the adjunction, generation, and the adjoint-kernel-zero lemma (proof lines 4723-4740).
